title: Towards Human-AI Synergy in Requirements Engineering: A Framework and Preliminary Study

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes mitigating automation bias through a human-in-the-loop conceptual framework (HARE-SM) and prototype tool, though empirical measurement is marked as planned for future field trials rather than conducted in this preliminary study.

The authors developed a prototype tool (Acceptance Criteria Assistant) that logs and compares multi-model LLM outputs side-by-side to allow stakeholders to trace and surface biases; actual empirical evaluation is designated for planned future phases.
